description: K₃NaMgCr₂O₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both K-O bond lengths are 2.90 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.59-3.12 Å. Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.31 Å. Mg is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Mg-O bond lengths are 2.00 Å. Cr is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.66-1.81 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one K, one Na, one Mg, and one Cr atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to four K and one Cr atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one K and one Cr atom.
